[[Broodoo Victim]]s |teleport = [[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|CKR}}
[[Tai Bwo Wannai teleport|Teleport scroll]] |music = [[Tribal Background]] |map = {{Map|name=Tai Bwo Wannai|x=2795|y=3065|height=250|zoom=1}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Karamja }} {{Relative location |location = Tai Bwo Wannai |north = Brimhaven |east = Shipyard (Karamja){{!}}Karamja Shipyard |south = Shilo Village (location){{!}}Shilo Village |west = Yanille }} '''Tai Bwo Wannai''', meaning 'small clearing in the jungle',{{CiteNPC|npc=Trufitus|quote=It means 'small clearing in the jungle' but it is now the name of our village.|loc=Jungle Potion|notes=|name=}} is a village located south of [[Brimhaven]] in the jungle of [[Karamja]]. It is home to a number of villagers. Unfortunately for its residents, the surrounding jungle grows back rapidly after being cut down, often housing deadly [[broodoo victim]]s with high health, strong damage, and stat-reducing [[spells]]. == Transportation == Several methods exist for reaching the village: * {{Plink|Tai bwo wannai teleport}} — centre of the village * {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|CKR}} — south of the village. * {{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — south of the village. * {{plink|Lady of the Waves|pic=War ship}} — Cairn Island. Leaves from [[Port Khazard]] for a fee of 20-50 [[coins]]. * {{Plink|Karamja gloves 3}} or better — [[Shilo Village]]. With 79 [[Agility]], players can scale the [[Rocks (Shilo Village)|rocks]] near the north-eastern corner of the village wall. * {{Plink|Abyss|pic=Skull (status) icon}} — nature altar, south-east of the village. Players will be [[Skull (status)|skulled]] if they are not wearing an [[abyssal bracelet]] when entering the Abyss. * {{Plink|Brimhaven teleport}} — well north of the village. * {{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — well east of the village. * {{Plink|Ogre boat|pic=Raft icon}} — east of the village. Players can only use it if coming from the [[Feldip Hills]], and if they provide two [[Raw chompy|raw]] or [[Cooked chompy|cooked chompies]]. Due to its strange placement and requirements, it is rarely used. Finally, players can dock at [[Cairn Isle]] at level 42 [[Sailing]] and run north. == History == {{LoreSources|Jungle Potion|Tai Bwo Wannai Trio|Shilo Village|Varrock Museum|the4=yes}} The village has a long history, and the local people descend from tribes who lived in the area since at least the [[Fourth Age]]. In more recent years, the residents were afraid of staying in the village, until [[Player character|an adventurer]] helped the village gather the materials needed for the residents to commune with their gods and ensure they hadn't angered them. The adventurer relayed this information to the sons of the chief, which led them to return to the village. Later, the adventurer helped protect the village by resolving the threat of [[Rashiliyia]]. ==Locations== ===Buildings=== {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Anvil]] building |A building in the northern section of the village featuring an anvil. |- |[[Jiminua's Jungle Store]] |A [[general store]] a bit north-west of the village. |- |[[Sharimika]]'s home |An elevated hut housing Sharimika. |- |[[Layleen]]'s home |An elevated hut housing Layleen. |- |[[Tamayu's Spear Stall]] |The house and venue of Tamayu, offering poisoned [[spears]] and [[cleaning cloth|cleaning cloths]] after [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]]. |- |[[Tiadeche's Karambwan Stall]] |The house and venue of Tiadeche, offering [[karambwans]] and catching items after [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]]. |- |[[Timfraku]]'s home |A two-story building housing Timfraku. |- |[[Tinsay]]'s home |An elevated hut housing Tinsay. |- |[[Trufitus]]' home |The home of Trufitus, found just west of the [[Hardwood Grove]]. |} There are also several [[Shop|shops]]: * The [[Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.|Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative]], which trades [[trading sticks]] for clothing and other items. * The [[Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Drinky Store.|Tai Bwo Wannai Drink Store]], which purchases gnome cocktails. *The [[Rionasta|Tai Bwo Wannai Parcel Service]], where [[Rionasta]] runs items to your bank for a fee of 10 trading sticks per item. ===Skill training areas=== *The [[Hardwood Grove|hardwood grove]] to the east of the town gives access to [[teak]] and [[mahogany]] trees, at a cost of 100 [[trading sticks]]. *A [[calquat tree patch]] can be found just east of the anvil, used for planting [[calquat tree]]s. *An [[anvil]] in the northern-most building. *The [[Karamja Jungle mine]] can be found immediately south-east of the village. ===Other=== *The minigame [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] can be found in the village, offering rewards such as the [[gout tuber]]. *To the west of the village is a secret entrance to the [[bronze dragon]] area of the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]], accessible after paying [[Banisoch]] a one-off fee of 5,000 [[trading stick]]s. *A [[Tribal Statue|tribal statue]] in the centre of the area can recharge [[prayer]] points after completion of [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]]. === Spawns === {| class="wikitable align-center-3"" !colspan=2|Item !Spawns !Map |-
